globus_home.description: Base directory for Globus runtime files, certificates, and temporary data.

bind_interface.description: Network interface to bind the control listener to (e.g., 'eth0'). Leave empty to bind to all interfaces.

control_port.description: TCP port used for GridFTP control connections.

data_port_min.description: Lowest TCP port available for passive data connections.

data_port_max.description: Highest TCP port available for passive data connections.

tls_enabled.description: Enable TLS encryption for control and data channels.

tls_cert_path.description: Path to the server’s TLS certificate (PEM format). Required if TLS is enabled.

tls_key_path.description: Path to the server’s TLS private key (PEM format, unencrypted). Required if TLS is enabled.

tls_protocol.description: Supported TLS protocol versions (e.g., '1.2', '1.2:1.3'). Avoid insecure protocols like SSLv3 or TLS 1.0.

client_cert_verify.description: Require and verify client TLS certificates (mTLS). Use with GridFTP GSI authentication.

ca_cert_path.description: Path to CA certificate bundle or directory for verifying client certificates. Required if `client_cert_verify` is true.

max_connections.description: Maximum number of concurrent client connections allowed.

max_threads.description: Maximum number of worker threads handling I/O operations.

rfc3540_enabled.description: Enable RFC 3540 extensions (e.g., MLSD, MFMT) for modern FTP clients.

log_path.description: File path for server logs. If empty, logs go to system syslog.

tcp_nodelay.description: Disable Nagle’s algorithm for lower latency data transfers.

auth_methods.description: Ordered list of supported authentication mechanisms.

authz_rules.description: GSI-based authorization rules for fine-grained access control.

chroot_dirs.description: List of chroot directories to restrict users’ filesystem access.

allowed_groups.description: List of groups whose members may authenticate and use the service.

timeout_idle.description: Seconds of inactivity before the server closes a control connection.

timeout_data.description: Seconds of inactivity before the server closes a data connection.
